description_en: Retrieves the details of an alert
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --alert-uuid 'sas_71e24437d2797ce8fc59692905a4****' --role-for 1130916744880000 --role-type 1 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAlert

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.

Note: This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the service returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。

注意：此参数实际为必填项，未提供时服务返回 400 错误
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the alert associated with the event.

Note: This parameter is required. If you do not specify this parameter, the service returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh:
事件关联告警ID。

注意：此参数实际为必填项，未提供时服务返回 400 错误
parameters.name: alert_uuid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:
0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

Alert.description_en:
Indicates whether the minor version is not the latest version.

If the minor version of your server is not the latest, the sampled logs may be inaccurate, resulting in inaccurate IP address statistics. Therefore, we recommend that you upgrade the minor version of your server as soon as possible
Alert.description_zh:
若该值为 true 时，则说明小版本不是最新版本。

如果您的服务端小版本不是最新版本，会导致采样日志不够精确，最终导致统计的IP信息不够精准。因此建议您尽快升级服务端小版本
